QUESTIONS ANSWERED

AI Solutions & Agents FAQ

Technical safety, data privacy, hallucination guardrails, and enterprise integration.

We implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with strict semantic guardrails. The AI is explicitly bounded to reference only your approved knowledge base documents, pricing tables, and product catalogs. If a user asks a question outside your verified documentation, the agent politely admits it lacks that information and routes the inquiry to a human specialist.
Never. We deploy enterprise-tier API endpoints (such as OpenAI Enterprise, Anthropic Claude API, and Google Vertex AI) which legally bind that your submitted data and prompts are never retained for model training. All vectorized embeddings are stored in private, encrypted vector databases owned by your company.
Our setup fee covers architecture, prompting, RAG vector pipeline, frontend widget integration, and testing. Ongoing API token usage (usually $5–$25/month for typical SME website traffic) is billed directly by the model provider to your payment card. We implement rate limiting and caching to keep token consumption as lean as possible.
Yes. We build webhook and API integrations connecting your AI agent to HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Notion, Slack alerts, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp Business. When a high-value lead is qualified, the agent can instantly generate a CRM deal and notify your sales team via Slack.
We engineer seamless human handoff protocols. The agent captures the customer's contact info, summarizes the entire chat conversation, and sends an urgent email, SMS, or CRM ticket notification to your on-call team so they can pick up the conversation immediately with full context.
Yes. We offer optional ongoing AI maintenance retainers to periodically re-index your knowledge base as your products change, monitor conversation logs for edge cases, adjust prompt parameters, and upgrade models when faster or cheaper LLM releases become available.
